activities.description: Introduces the topic of cranial nerves.
Explains the model showing both sides of the brain.
Begins pointing out and naming cranial nerves in order.
Identifies optic nerve and optic chiasm.
Identifies glossopharyngeal, vagus, accessory, and hypoglossal nerves.

characterInteraction.description: The Instructor speaks directly to the audience.
